title: Versioning Published MCP Servers
excerpt: The MCP Registry is currently in preview. Breaking changes or data resets may occur before general availability. If you encounter any issues, please report them on GitHub. MCP servers MUST define a version string in server.json. For example: The version string MUST be unique for each publication of the server. Once published, the version string (and other metadata) cannot be changed. Version Format The MCP Registry recommends semantic versioning, but supports any version string format.
